summary: Upgrade reusable workflows to Node 24 actions

delivery.outcome: Hub and reusable governance workflows run only immutable, official Node.js 24 action releases without changing their external behavior
nonGoals: No workflow event, permission, input, condition or GitHub API script changes
No governance package version or adoption payload change
No downstream standard-reference update inside this ticket

architecture.decision: Replace only immutable action revisions with Node.js 24 releases; retain github-script v8 to avoid the unrelated v9 API migration
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket before downstream repositories adopt the new immutable standard revision

commands: inspect official action.yml at each pinned revision
validation.evidence: Every checkout and setup-python reference resolves to an official action declaring node24
Both github-script v8 steps execute unchanged against the protected GitHub event
All required jobs pass and ticket-owned action steps emit no Node.js 20 annotations
todo2code records provider unavailability fail-closed without fallback, while independent Validator GLM review binds and approves the exact PR head
